A step of 1 m at 768 m is 0.075 deg of skyline; the Sun crosses that in about 9 minutes at the equator.
Eased mode: the 3 m models as T-32 makes the app load them (rule from its handover; lib/lunyx_dem.py eased_fine). The "just outside minus just inside"
columns read the two grids 3 m apart, so they keep about 3 m of the ground's own slope; "same points" reads both grids at the same points of the
edge (0.01 m inside it, every 3 m), T-32's own measure, 60 m window minus 3 m model.
